ratings_why.fun: Lots of cross-wiring to play with (Almoner against Stretch-Holder, flooding your own Dive coots, Overflow turning Drain into water), though the Vote payoffs themselves are plain +stats per Vote.
ratings_why.distinct: Over a 7: a scouted up-or-down Vote on a waterline both boards share makes unit shape (Health against Attack) the puzzle, and Lowering below 0 is a built-in answer to the mirror; no tribe today plays like that.

verdict_why: One core rule needs a line (does an Under unit hit back at half when attacked?); otherwise it is close to settled.

points.text: Under says a unit 'attacks with half its Attack', but both units deal damage at once. Say whether an Under unit also deals half when it is the one attacked; this decides how much the water really protects.

Board Almoner feeding units at or below your Level, while Stretch-Holder and Schouw-Walker lift them out of its reach, is the best tension in the tribe. One more card that pays when your own unit goes Under would make self-flooding a full build, not just a Dive trick.
Gauge-Keeper of Stillwater fed by Master of the Nine Mills and Schouw-Walker grows its own water; with Tiddy Mun that is a fun high roll. Worth a sim, not a cut.
Keeper of the Overflow is a great off-label bridge: a Board at Level below 0 floods only its own fights. A second Lower-to-water card at a low tier would let Pumped Flood start earlier.
Kees Kowk reaching back-row Under units pairs nicely with Ditch Coot's Flood; a mid-tier coot that copies this reach would give the flood build a real way past walls.

standouts.why: Board Almoner rewards keeping units low, which fights every other Health buff on your board: a real placement choice each turn.
Keeper of the Overflow turns the Drain build's Lowers into water, merging two builds that look opposed.
Master of the Nine Mills pays either direction, so swinging the Level to the matchup is income rather than waste.

weakest.why: The Spaarndam Pup is a plain Health stacker with one Vote; it does its job and nothing else.
Penningmeester Hiske is gold per Lower and nothing more; no overlap with the water itself.
Sail-Setter is a standard 'beside gains stats' buffer with a Vote trigger.

flags.note: Water grows with its own Health; fed tall plus Tiddy Mun, it could drown most enemies at Start of Combat. Golden doubles both parts.
Drowning at half the water all fight, stacked with Gauge-Keeper or a big Overflow, may wipe wide boards before they act.
A big Start of Combat water rise sinks many enemies at once, so The Winter Raft may hit its six triggers before any attack.
